_comment: Wave 2 fixture config TEMPLATE for issue #3968. Copy OUTSIDE this repo, then replace every <PLACEHOLDER>. No credentials of any kind: the harness rejects any top-level key whose name contains token/secret/password/credential. Bearer tokens are named INDIRECTLY, by env var name, under identity_env. Values marked VERIFIED were confirmed read-only against the live account on 2026-09-24; values marked PLACEHOLDER must be filled from the actual fixture you create.
gateway_url: <PLACEHOLDER: base URL of the flag-ON isolated fixture gateway>
live_run_id: <PLACEHOLDER: event_id of the live fixture run>
terminal_run_id: <PLACEHOLDER: event_id of a terminal fixture row>
aborted_run_id: <PLACEHOLDER: event_id of the synthetic aborted fixture row (W2-06)>
deployed_digest: <PLACEHOLDER: sha256:... digest serving the FIXTURE gateway; printed by 10-create-fixture.sh, which pins it by digest. This is the dedicated fixture's own pin and does not depend on what any ordinary workload is running>
_identity_env_comment: All THREE roles are mandatory: the harness resolves owner/nonowner/other_tenant and raises PrerequisiteMissingError if any is absent, because with fewer than three it cannot tell 'not yours' apart from 'does not exist'. These are env var NAMES; export the bearer values separately at execution time. 40-verify-edge-sessions.sh confirms all three resolve to genuinely distinct principals before the harness runs.
